# Onshape

> Cloud-native CAD and PDM platform enabling real-time design collaboration, parametric modeling, and integrated product data management for modern product development teams.

Onshape is a comprehensive product development platform that combines 3D CAD design, Product Data Management (PDM), and PLM integration in a cloud-native environment. The platform serves professional designers, engineers, educators, and enterprises seeking collaborative, browser-based design tools with version control and manufacturing capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Cloud-native CAD
- Product Data Management (PDM)
- Design Collaboration
- Part Studio
- FeatureScript
- Parametric Modeling
- Bill of Materials (BOM)
- Assembly Design
- Version Control & Branching
- Sheet Metal Design
- Release Management
- PLM Integration
- Custom Features
- Render Studio
- Product Development Platform

## Platform Overview

- [Onshape | Product Development Platform](https://www.onshape.com/en): Homepage introducing Onshape cloud-native CAD, PDM, and design platform.
- [Why Onshape?](https://www.onshape.com/en/why-onshape): Value proposition highlighting cloud computing, collaboration, and PDM benefits.
- [Cloud-Native CAD & PDM](https://www.onshape.com/en/platform): Platform overview of Onshape's CAD, PDM, and PLM integration capabilities.

## CAD Design Features

- [3D CAD Software](https://www.onshape.com/en/spotlight/3d-cad-software): 3D CAD design software capabilities with parametric modeling and PDM features.
- [Parts Design in 3D CAD Software](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/parts-modeling): Part Studio modeling with FeatureScript custom features and parametric design.
- [Onshape Assemblies](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/assemblies): Assembly design with mates, exploded views, and dynamic motion capabilities.
- [Online CAD Drawing Software](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/drawings): Cloud-based CAD drawing creation with synchronization and manufacturing docs.
- [Surface Modeling in CAD Design](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/surfacing): Parametric surface modeling with curvature continuity and geometry analysis.

## Specialized Design Workflows

- [CAD Design Software for Sheet Metal](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/sheet-metal): Sheet metal design with K-factor, flat patterns, and manufacturing integration.
- [Frame Design in CAD: Fast & Efficient Structural Frames](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/frames): Structural frame design with standard profiles, trimming, and cut list generation.
- [3D CAD Configurations for Products & Parts](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/configurations): Part and assembly configurations with parametric control and design efficiency.

## Product Data Management & Collaboration

- [Product Data Management](https://www.onshape.com/en/spotlight/product-data-management): Built-in PDM system for collaboration, version control, and data management.
- [Product Data Management (PDM) Software With CAD Integration](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/product-data-management): PDM software with CAD integration, branching, and release management features.
- [Branch & Merge in CAD Design](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/branch-merge-cad): Version control branching and merging for design variations and experimentation.
- [Release Management for CAD | Version & Revision Control](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/release-management): Release workflows with approval processes and revision control for CAD designs.
- [Bill of Materials (BOM) in CAD](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/bill-of-materials): Dynamic BOM management with real-time updates and ERP system integration.
- [CAD, PDM & PLM Integration: Onshape-Arena Connection](https://www.onshape.com/en/features/onshape-arena-connection): CAD, PDM, PLM integration with Arena for cloud-native product development.
